behavior.approval: BTC EVM approve creates/updates Cosmos bank SendAuthorization; ordinary bridgeOut consumes it atomically. No Cosmos signer is needed.
behavior.sourceCalls: bridgeERC20 and bridgeOut are nonpayable with value zero. Source success does not establish delivery.
behavior.inbound: A valid enabled ERC20, current mapping, expected mUSDC runtime/minter and non-module recipient are required. A skipped or failed system mint may advance the sequence; destination settlement must be proved separately.
behavior.outboundFee: When collector is nonzero: floor(amount * (percentageExempt ? 0 : withdrawalFee) / BASIS_POINTS_DENOMINATOR) + flatWithdrawalFees[token]. Zero collector disables fees; fee >= amount reverts. uint256 multiplication/addition overflow reverts.
behavior.feeBound: Source bridgeOut has no max destination fee argument. A quote bound is checked during preparation/simulation/submission; it cannot guarantee the later settlement fee.
behavior.recovery: WithdrawalFailed after confirmation requires governance recovery; expose governance-recovery-required and never retry or resend automatically.

limitations: No live value-bearing transfer, new dependency or local node was used.
Historical real transfers prove the retained generations. Current state/source compatibility is additional bounded evidence, not a fresh end-to-end transfer.
RPC-reported client version is an operator assertion, not cryptographic proof of native engine code or past execution.
Current delivery needs runtime/tuple/settlement evidence at candidate coordinates; ambiguous inbound batches remain unproven.
Runtime changes invalidate this bounded qualification. No route support or release promotion is implied.
